messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — scheduling a config-only deploy in the 11:15 PT change window. Target: prepaid routing + batching/timeouts to reduce tail latency for short chat requests. Will push a scoped policy and smaller batch window for prepaid-tier, no model binary changes.
aj: SGTM. Can we add a temporary alert on prepaid 5xx and queue-length?
maria: yep will add 5xx > 0.5% and queue_len > 30 as thresholds. Also planning 5% canary -> 25% -> full over ~35m if metrics look ok.
leo: thumbs-up from infra. make sure dedicated pools not affected.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maria for 1854732011-config (config-only) — change-window 11:15 PT. Canary: 5% for 10m, ramp to 25% for 15m, then gradual.
sara: oncall during window, ping me at start + at canary end. I can rollback quickly if error rate spikes.
maria: noted. config snippet below:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  prepaid-tier:
    max_concurrent_requests: 60
    request_timeout_ms: 1200
    response_timeout_ms: 2800
    batch_window_ms: 12
    max_batch_size: 16
    fallback_model: rwd-v1.6.3-quant
    qos: low-latency
rolling_strategy:
  canary_percent: [5, 25, 100]
  canary_intervals_min: [10, 15, 10]
```
aj: nice. can we also pin routing to region us-west-2 for the canary only? avoids cross-region noise.
maria: doing that for canary stage. full rollout will be global.
deploy-bot: deploy started (config-only) — 5% canary to us-west-2 at 11:15:07 PT. ID: cfg-1854732011-a.
deploy-bot: canary health check started (metrics: 200s, 5xx, latency p95).
sara: watching dashboards. initial 5xx = 0, p95 ~ 420ms, queue_len ~ 6. :thumbsup:
leo: CPU on canary hosts +8% but within headroom.
ops_oncall: note — added temp alert channel #ops-alerts for this rollout.
deploy-bot: canary OK, ramping to 25% at 11:26 PT.
maria: rolling to 25% now, leaving pin to us-west for the 25% stage too.
deploy-bot: 25% stage healthy after 15m. No increase in 5xx. p95 increased to 480ms on prepaid but within SLOs.
sara: small p95 bump expected, but tail looks improved over baseline for short payloads. keep an eye for retries.
aj: cool. let's keep a 2 hour monitor and then finalize release notes.
maria: noted. final rollout to 100% starting 11:50 PT.
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete at 11:58 PT. config-only deploy finished. ID: cfg-1854732011-a.
sara: post-deploy check: prepaid 5xx = 0.3%, p95 = 490ms, queue_len = 9. no obvious errors. will keep monitoring for 2h.
leo: filing a small follow-up task to revisit max_concurrent_requests after 24h of traffic.
maria: thanks all. I'll add an entry to release notes: "config: prepaid routing — reduced batch window, stricter timeouts, region-pinned canary; improved short-request tail latency" and mark as config-only.
aj: tx — add a line about temporary us-west canary pin.
maria: done. closing thread after monitoring window.
